conventions.permutations: Index 0..23 = lexicographic order of one-line notation of S_4 (index 0 = identity 1234). contact_set_oneline gives the images of 1,2,3,4. P_sigma has a 1 in row i, column sigma(i).
conventions.F_sigma: F_sigma = alpha * prod_{i=1..4} (a_i + b_{sigma(i)}); complex numbers are stored as [re, im].
conventions.gaps: gaps[sigma] = Re F_sigma - Re F_ref with ref = reference_permutation_index = the minimizer, so all gaps >= 0 (this is the vector P c(x) of the paper). Rescaled (alpha multiplied by a positive real) so that the 24 gaps sum to 1.
conventions.contact: contact set = {sigma : gap = 0}; contact_residual is max |gap| over the contact set (absolute, equals relative to the largest gap times max gap); smallest_noncontact_gap is the smallest gap outside T.
conventions.generators: generators = f_j of Appendix D vanishing on T (lib generators(T)), name n<I>,<J> (minor) or h<pi>,<+/-> (non-minor); decomposition: gaps ~ sum_j coefficient_j * (P f_j), coefficients >= 0 by NNLS.
conventions.O_min: multistart (40) BFGS minimizer over SO(4) of Phi_c(O) = sum_sigma sgn(sigma) gaps_sigma prod_i O[i][sigma(i)].
conventions.O_hard: minimizer over SO(4) of Phi_h for the non-minor generator h with the largest positive coefficient; phi_c_at_O_hard = Phi_c(O_hard) for the actual gap vector; det = det(D_a + O D_b O^t) (complex); sigma_points = prod_i (a_i + b_sigma(i)) in the 24-permutation order. Phi_c(O) = Re(alpha*det - F_ref) before rescaling, after rescaling use the stored alpha.

provenance.seeds: configuration search seeds 1000*k + s, s = 0..11; margins cycle [0.05, 0.02, 0.01]; 40 random starts per seed; min_phi seeds 7 (O_min) and 11 (O_hard)
provenance.tolerances: stratum solver (own copy of the lib formulation, max_nfev 120, 40 starts) tol 1e-8, then Gauss-Newton polish to ~1e-16; contact set recheck tol 1e-10*max gap; configurations kept only if smallest non-contact gap > 1e-4 (sum of gaps = 1)
provenance.note: All values are floating point numerical data, NOT certificates. min_phi values are upper bounds of true minima.
